title: Charged a subscription I didn’t know of
body: You can read all other reviews. Many people had been unfairly charged, and it’s impossible to find until I had to call the bank and figure out. USD30.99 a month. Ridiculous. According to their response, they wrote that the auto subscriptions is written  in their T&C. Why can’t you write it loud and clear in the sales order and not hide it in the T&C fine print if you are transparent. I’m not the first complain. The developers if sincere, should do something about this. It’s such a small change to your email template. And god. If we need to email you to cancel subscription, at least reply in 2 days not in 6 days!
author: Yuuuhwen
